maudhui: (1) All executive functions of the Government of the United Republic shall be discharged by officers of the Government on behalf of the President. (2) Orders and other directives issued for the purposes of this Article shall be authenticated in such manner as shall be specified in regulations made by the President, subject to the provisions of this Constitution.
